Look at the stark contrast between a society that still has its backbone and the pathetic, hand-wringing globalists who are whining about rising energy prices and canceled flights while death and destruction fill screens. While weak-kneed progressives sit around crying about a poorly planned, unwinnable war that is a peril to global well-being, the Israeli people understand what national survival actually takes. 

As Bloomberg reports, people across the world are asking when the Iran war will stop, but thank God for traditional resolve and unyielding authority: "Not in Israel, where the public is strongly behind seeing the war through until [...]" 

That is what happens when a country prioritizes strength, security, and cultural continuity instead of bowing down to weakness and international institutions. While the modern West loses its moral compass and forgets personal responsibility, Israel is showing us how a nation stands firm to protect its homeland. We desperately need that kind of defense of our own borders, security, and traditional values right here at home.
